name: @sos-2/worker-runtimes
description: SOS 2.0 Worker Runtime Host (Work Order P8): the local reference of the external worker topology — a plain Node + TypeScript host that leases a reference body through the P5 Body Broker, executes a bounded task in the @sos-2/sandbox bounded environment, emits observations/artifacts through the typed execution-fabric boundaries, and releases the body. NO long-running work inside any request lifetime: the host runs on an INJECTED tick/command source (poll-driven, testable offline — no ambient timers). The §7 user-device model is enforced at the scheduling gate: cloud/remote bodies run regardless of the user's device (the task continues while the user's computer is off — pinned by tests with the device reported offline), user-device bodies QUEUE while the device is offline and resume when it returns. Body replacement mid-task rides the fabric's replaceBodyForTask (task identity and state preserved). Honest completion discipline (§10): the host builds the Spirit-side verification record from the executed step outcomes (evidence refs = observation ids + captured artifact ids); a denied, unsupported or failed step completes the task with verified:false — never fabricated. The only impure boundary is the composition root (system clock injection), mirroring the apps/api precedent.
